name: ssh-remote-ops
description: 按用户显式提供的主机、端口、用户名、私钥路径、独立配置文件、命令白名单和远端路径允许列表做远程操作。这些项都必填且无默认值，未填写时保持 setup_required。不读取本机 SSH 配置或凭据，不默认连接。本包不是 Kimi 原包。

host.title: SSH host
host.description: Required host or address. No default. Do not use an alias that depends on the machine SSH config.

port.title: SSH port
port.description: Required port. No default. This package does not preset 22.

private_key_path.title: Private key path
private_key_path.description: Required explicit key file path. Do not use ~/.ssh/id_rsa or a profile key. This package does not read the file. Do not put key material in this value.

ssh_config_file.title: Explicit SSH config file
ssh_config_file.description: Required because upstream --ssh-config-file defaults to ~/.ssh/config. Point at a file created for this plugin. Do not point at the machine SSH config.

whitelist.title: Command whitelist
whitelist.description: Required. Upstream says any command is allowed when no whitelist is set. No default pattern.

allowed_remote_paths.title: Remote path allowlist
allowed_remote_paths.description: Required. Upstream allows any remote path when this is unset. No default.
